ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access — confidential beneficial ownership information is filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission and is accessible to the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit, domestic law enforcement and competent authorities; no public UBO register exists

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public or Commissioner for Oaths in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille issued by the competent authority of the country of origin; Consular Legalization through a Vanuatu diplomatic mission if the origin country is not a party to the Hague Apostille Convention

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility provider, bank, or tax authority in the country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarial certification followed by Hague Apostille

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: PEP self-declaration and source of wealth / source of funds questionnaire

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of the company, all ultimate beneficial owners, directors, and senior officers against the OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, and the Vanuatu domestic financial watch-list at onboarding and on a continuous basis thereafter. PEP determination follows FATF Recommendation 12, requiring enhanced due diligence for politically exposed persons: senior management approval, verified source of funds and source of wealth, and enhanced transaction monitoring. Negative media and adverse-information screening against open sources is performed and logged in the client risk file. The entity's banking AML risk tier is classified as Low_Risk_Standard for the online auto-parts e-commerce segment.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Corporate Registry — vfsc.vu e-services; name clearance and incorporation filings are lodged exclusively through a VFSC-licensed registered agent
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names may be in English, French, or Bislama; any non-Roman script must be transliterated into Roman characters. The legal name must end with a statutory suffix: Limited, Ltd, Corporation, Corp, Incorporated, Inc, Société Anonyme, or S.A. The proposed name must not imply a purpose other than the stated corporate objects, and any token suggesting regulated financial activity requires the appropriate licence or ministerial consent.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Bank, Banking, Trust, Trustee, Insurance, Assurance, Reinsurance, Fund, Futures, Exchange, Broker, Financial Services — require a VFSC financial services licence or prior ministerial consent
Government, Municipal, Commonwealth, Royal, Chartered, University, Chamber of Commerce — imply state patronage and require ministerial consent
Names identical or deceptively similar to existing names on the VFSC company register
Names contrary to public policy or implying activity outside the lawful objects of an International Company under the International Companies Act
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the VFSC-licensed registered agent may file a written reconsideration request with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the rejection notice, attaching explanatory submissions and any required ministerial approvals. If the Registrar upholds the rejection, the applicant may appeal in writing within 21 days to the Minister responsible for financial services, whose determination is subject to judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu. Additional reconsideration fees apply under the VFSC fee schedule.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for the online auto-parts e-commerce activity. The International Company must maintain a registered office and a VFSC-licensed registered agent at premises in Port Vila, serving exclusively as the statutory service address. Trading operations — online retail of automotive replacement parts and tuning accessories — may be conducted entirely remotely without a physical Vanuatu presence, provided the IC does not carry on business within Vanuatu. A separate operating address outside Vanuatu is advisable for payment processor onboarding (Stripe and PayPal) and to evidence genuine foreign economic substance.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (below 5%) for the IC's remote operational premises; moderate risk of on-site inspection at the licensed registered agent's office as part of routine VFSC AML/CFT supervision; corporate records must be retrievable on demand through the registered agent.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (as amended), sections 4, 13, 14, 20, 23 and 41
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of an International Company, together with Form IC-1 (Statement of Incorporation)
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital for an International Company; stated capital may be fixed in any recognized currency. No escrow or capital deposit account is required at incorporation.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: The subscribers of Vanuatu International Company No. [·] hereby resolve: (1) that the company subscribe to the issued shares set forth in the Statement of Share Capital and that such subscription be accepted; (2) that the registered office of the company be established at the address provided by the registered agent, and that the agent is authorized to accept service of process; (3) that the persons named in the resolution be appointed as the inaugural directors and officers; (4) that the directors be authorized to open bank and online payment accounts, engage professional counsel, and complete all filings necessary for the company's online automotive parts retail business; and (5) that this resolution take effect immediately.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – online name reservation portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit two proposed company names for availability check. The name must end with 'Limited' or 'International Company' or approved abbreviation. Reserve the approved name for 30 days upon payment of the reservation fee.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused or found confusingly similar, submit a revised name or file a written objection and supporting trade-mark evidence for reconsideration within 7 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation of Constitutive Documents and Registered Agent Engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a VFSC-licensed registered agent to prepare the Memorandum and Articles of Association, Statement of Share Capital, particulars of directors and officers, and registered office consent. The agent must verify the identity of all subscribers and maintain statutory records.
required_dossiers: Proof of identity and address for each officer
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent requests additional due diligence, provide certified bilingual translations or notarized copies. Refile corrected constitutive documents without additional state fee if corrected within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission to VFSC and Payment of Fees
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC International Companies Registry – physical counter or authorized agent e-filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the signed constitutive documents and Form IC-1 through the registered agent. Pay the incorporation fee and annual license fee for the first year. The application is reviewed for completeness, statutory compliance, and name availability.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues an objection on formality grounds, the registered agent corrects and resubmits. Where the application is refused, appeal to VFSC Board within 30 days or amend the proposed business object clause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC registers the company in the International Companies Register and issues the Certificate of Incorporation, official company number, and certified extract of registered particulars.
required_dossiers: No new filings required – VFSC internal registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If certificate contains a name or date scrivener error, submit a written rectification request to VFSC Registry with the original certificate; corrected certificate issued within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establishment of Registered Office and Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and first board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Adopt the first board resolution to confirm the registered office address, appointment of directors and officers, and approval of share subscription. Open the company's corporate register, seal register, share transfer ledger, and minutes book at the registered office.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered office consent is not in proper form, the registered agent submits a fresh consent; no re-submission to VFSC is needed unless registered office address changes.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Commencement Steps for E-Commerce Operations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC, Vanuatu Department of Customs & Inland Revenue, and commercial banks/payment processors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain company certificate copies for bank account and Stripe/PayPal onboarding. If the company holds local inventory, obtain municipal occupation permit and fire clearance. No VFSC operating licence is required for offshore retail e-commerce of automotive aftermarket parts.
required_dossiers: Local required permits (if physical storage in Vanuatu)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment processor requests further evidence, request a VFSC letter of good standing. If municipality issues permit deficiency notice, submit structural floor plan and fire safety certificate to the relevant municipal council.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Authority and Shefa Province or relevant Municipal Council for physical trade premises; no federal/state industrial license applies to pure e-commerce sales
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Municipal Business Occupation Permit (if local warehouse or showroom is operated) and VFSC International Company Annual License

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration/Exempt for small-scale e-commerce warehousing with no manufacturing; full EIA only if warehousing includes hazardous liquids, solvent storage, or spray-painting operations
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharge to municipal sewer shall comply with Vanuatu National Environment Standards; volatile organic compound emissions from any incidental aerosol/coating products below 100 kg per month; waste oil and used batteries must be stored in sealed containers and disposed to authorized recycler

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services for any occupied warehouse/office; structural load clearance from the Municipal Council building control; occupational safety risk assessment and first-aid compliance for employees; importation of automotive parts must not include asbestos or banned refrigerants per Vanuatu trading standards

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu does not maintain an income tax administration. The relevant authorities are (1) Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for International Company registration and licensing, www.vfsc.vu; (2) Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue (VCIR), a division of the Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, for customs and municipal business licence administration; and (3) municipal councils in Port Vila and Luganville for local business licences.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: There is no statutory national TIN or VAT ID in Vanuatu. A foreign-owned International Company (IC) obtains its corporate identifier through the following procedure: (1) an approved VFSC registered agent files the incorporation documents and registered office details under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); (2) the VFSC issues a Certificate of Incorporation and a VFSC Company Number; (3) if the IC maintains a physical presence in Vanuatu, it obtains a municipal business licence from the relevant local council; (4) if the IC imports or exports goods, it registers with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue for customs processing and obtains an importer/exporter code; and (5) where a bank account is opened, the bank carries out customer due diligence and may record local tax identifiers of beneficial owners, but no central tax registration number is issued.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Tax_Exempt_Zone: a Vanuatu International Company is a non-resident offshore entity treated as tax-exempt in Vanuatu. It is not subject to income tax, corporate tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax, VAT, or stamp duty on its offshore business transactions, provided it does not trade within Vanuatu or engage in domestic prohibited activities.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no income tax and therefore no check-the-box or hybrid mismatch tax elections. An International Company may elect, by special resolution, to adopt or amend its constitutional documents, change its share structure, convert to a company limited by guarantee, or deregister and move to another jurisdiction. No national tax entity-classification election exists because all International Companies have a single tax-exempt classification; nevertheless, an IC may voluntarily register as a Vanuatu domestic company under the Companies Act if it wishes to carry on local commercial activity, which would then bring it into municipal licensing and customs obligations.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None: Vanuatu does not operate a VAT, GST, or general sales and use tax system. The only indirect revenue measures are customs import duties, excise taxes on specified goods (tobacco, alcohol, fuel), stamp duty on immovable property transfers, and municipal business licence fees.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable: there is no VAT/GST registration threshold because no VAT/GST is imposed. Any business trading in Vanuatu must obtain a municipal business licence from the first day of operation regardless of turnover, and any importer/exporter must register with Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu has no electronic invoicing mandate, no real-time fiscal clearance system, and no digital stamping requirement for invoices. Commercial transactions are documented with ordinary paper or electronic invoices. Customs import and export declarations are processed through the ASYCUDA World electronic customs management system, but this does not constitute a tax-authority pre-clearance or invoice-clearing regime for indirect tax purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable: because Vanuatu has no VAT/GST, there is no export zero-rating mechanism and no VAT refund substantiation process. Exports of automotive aftermarket parts and tuning accessories by an International Company are outside the Vanuatu indirect tax net and are not subject to any export sales tax. Customs requires a formal export declaration for goods leaving Vanuatu for statistical and enforcement purposes, but no VAT form or VAT zero-rate claim is required.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged through ASYCUDA World
Commercial invoice showing exporter, importer, description, quantity, and value
Bill of lading or air waybill
Certificate of origin (if required by the destination customs authority or preferential trade claim)
Inward remittance or bank transfer record evidencing settlement of the export sale, where retained by the exporting IC's licensed Vanuatu bank
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: There is no export VAT zero-rating to audit, so no VAT clawback penalty exists. However, false customs declarations, undervaluation, misdescription, smuggling, or attempted exportation contrary to Vanuatu Customs legislation may result in seizure and forfeiture of the goods, monetary penalties based on evaded duties, criminal prosecution, and civil recovery by the Vanuatu Customs and Inland Revenue. Fraudulent representations to the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission in connection with International Company registration can result in fines, de-registration of the IC, and disqualification of directors; beneficial owners making deliberately false statements may also face professional negligence or money-laundering related sanctions under the Vanuatu AML/CFT framework. Vanuatu imposes no statutory foreign-exchange repatriation or clawback deadline on export proceeds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) – Exchange Control Department, acting under the Vanuatu Exchange Control Act [Cap.173] and delegated authorised-dealer arrangements with licensed commercial banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains a liberal current-account convertibility regime; the Vatu is convertible for all bona fide trade and service transactions. Capital-account inflows and outflows, including shareholder capital injections, loan repurchases and certain portfolio investments, require either RBV prior approval or delegated approval through an authorised dealer. Profit remittance for a tax-exempt International Company is generally permissible without exchange-control tax clearance, provided the company can evidence beneficial ownership, source of funds, and compliance with all applicable anti-money-laundering and counter-terrorist-financing requirements. The principal practical hurdle is documentary proof of the underlying trade, not conversion capacity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Export proceeds for online retail of automotive replacement parts and accessories must be repatriated to Vanuatu within 90 days from the date of export shipment, unless the exporter obtains prior deferred-payment approval from an authorised dealer. There is no mandatory conversion ratio into Vatu; exporters may retain foreign currency in approved foreign-currency accounts at a licensed commercial bank. However, the exporting entity must report all foreign-currency balances to the authorised dealer upon request and make the proceeds available for sale to the banking system if RBV deems it necessary in the national interest. Digital e-commerce proceeds are classified as current receipts and are subject to normal repatriation and record-keeping obligations, not special surrender licences.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational multi-currency account for e-commerce settlements and operating expenses
Operational current account plus separate foreign-currency treasury account
Operational account and internet-banking treasury rails

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium as a sole banking solution. Vanuatu does not currently operate a purpose-built e-money institution (EMI) licensing regime; non-bank fintechs may only undertake money-transfer activity under VFSC financial-dealer licensing and must demonstrate substantive physical presence. Offshore digital EMIs are therefore legally viable only as complementary settlement or disbursement gateways, not as primary custodians of treasury liquidity. The preferred architecture is a domestic commercial bank account as the principal account, with foreign EMIs used downstream solely for customer payouts or supplier payments in jurisdictions where such EMIs are licensed and regulated.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: All Vanuatu authorised dealers require corporate KYC to include beneficial ownership documentation, corporate registry extracts, proof of physical or registered office, and either an in-person interview with at least one director or a remote audio-visual interview with enhanced due diligence. For a Vanuatu International Company, non-resident directors are permitted and need not be physically present in Vanuatu, but the bank normally requires one signatory or director to complete an online/normal KYC interview and to provide notarised passport copies, a bank reference letter from the introducing bank, and the Certificate of Incumbency. Remote opening is permitted only where the introducing bank and documentary chain are acceptable to the Vanuatu compliance officer.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Undisclosed beneficial ownership or nominee-shareholder opacity in the Vanuatu International Company structure
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation; Certificate of Incumbency naming all directors and shareholders; beneficial ownership declaration; trust deed or foundation/trust documentation if any; notarised passports of all natural-person beneficial owners; bank reference letters from the introducing regulated bank; board resolution authorising account opening.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume e-commerce card-settlement fragmentation through Stripe and PayPal payout accounts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Up-to-date merchant agreements with Stripe and PayPal; payout bank references; downloadable transaction history; sales-order database extracts with customer names, SKUs and amounts; shipping and tracking records; reconciliation report matching received settlement to underlying online orders; signed end-customer invoices or terms of sale for all disputed transactions.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Mismatched beneficiary legal name versus remitting entity on inbound or outbound international wires
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Address-matching board resolution; commercial contracts and purchase orders; sales or supplier proforma invoices; shipping and customs declarations; letter of explanation from the counterparty; evidence of genuine trading relationship; such as e-commerce marketplace sales, supplier certifications, or exclusive-distribution agreements.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Large, sudden outward disbursements to component suppliers in low-cost manufacturing jurisdictions without clear trade trail
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Approve supplier file including due-diligence questionnaire; signed procurement agreements; purchase orders with quoted unit prices; shipping and bill-of-lading or AWB documents; inspection certificates where available; supplier bank details registered in the corporate ledger; Director-source-of-funds declaration; tax-exempt certificate issued to the Vanuatu IC where applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of private, intra-group shareholder loans for working capital triggering capital-account scrutiny
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed shareholder loan agreement with commercial terms; board resolutions approving drawdown and repayment; source-of-funds evidence for the lender; interest-rate justification and repayment schedule; consolidated group financial statements if applicable; notice of account debits and credits matching the loan schedule.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections must be remitted via SWIFT MT103 from the ultimate beneficial owner's or shareholder's own regulated bank account, using the full legal name of the Vanuatu International Company as beneficiary and the IC registration number as reference. The standard exchange-control reporting purpose should be 'capital account – equity participation' for ordinary shares or 'capital account – shareholder loan' for intercompany debt. RBV-authorised dealers require supporting board resolutions, share certificates, source-of-funds declarations, and if applicable a signed loan agreement with interest and maturity terms. All inbound funds are subject to normal OFAC/EU/UN sanctions screening and anti-money-laundering verification before credit is confirmed.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for automotive parts and accessories should be executed through direct SWIFT MT103 for supplier payments under USD 50,000 per transaction, and through commercial documentary letters of credit for larger or recurring supplier arrangements. The Vanuatu IC should issue clear proforma invoices and purchase orders with delivery terms (Incoterms 2020) for each disbursement; the authorised dealer will apply exchange-control form EX-1 or the bank's internal outward-remittance journal for reporting purposes. For countries with internal currency restrictions, the IC should use the bank's established corresponding-banking corridors and include the customer's import licence or regulatory approval in the covering schedule. Where possible, the IC should maintain a USD operational account to avoid unnecessary Vatu conversion friction, and supplier payments should be cleared via the bank's USD nostro network.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable forward contracts (USD/VUV, USD/AUD, USD/EUR) with an RBV-licensed authorised dealer, backed by confirmed underlying trade receivables or payables

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) covering currencies that are not freely deliverable in Vanuatu, such as CNY/USD or JPY/USD, provided the bank's risk committee approves the underlying e-commerce trade exposure
Cross-currency swaps executed only for balance-sheet hedging of shareholder loans or material procurement contracts, with maturity and notional aligned to the underlying commercial exposure

Spot and vanilla swap transactions under a pre-approved treasury dealing line with the primary Vanuatu bank, subject to standard credit support documentation and RBV exchange-control reporting thresholds

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Maintenance Fee (International Company Annual Renewal Payment)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the anniversary date of incorporation each year; VFSC practice permits a 30-day grace period from the anniversary date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment incurs VFSC late penalty of VUV 10,000 plus 10% surcharge; continued default beyond 90 days after the anniversary date exposes the International Company to administrative strike-off and dissolution without further notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Confirmation (Confirmation of Registered Agent, Registered Office and Shareholding Records)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Registered Agent acting for and on behalf of the International Company; underlying data maintained for VFSC inspection
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with the annual renewal payment; no later than 30 days after the anniversary date of incorporation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to confirm current records impairs the registered agent's ability to certify compliance; may lead to VFSC strike-off procedures against the company and disciplinary action against the agent.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit requirement for a standard exempt International Company under the International Companies Act. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only where the company holds a VFSC licence for regulated financial services activity or where members holding at least 10% of the issued shares resolve that an audit be undertaken.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS may be adopted, or US GAAP where consistently applied by shareholder agreement; International Companies are not required to prepare, file or publish statutory financial statements.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The International Company is not required to file an annual UBO return. However, the registered agent must maintain current identity records for all shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners, update these records within 30 days of any share transfer, and obtain an annual written confirmation from the company that no UBO or shareholding change has been omitted.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 450–900 per year depending on the registered agent and service provider
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not applicable for a standard exempt International Company; if voluntarily audited, USD 5,000–10,000 depending on transaction volume and reporting package

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory exemption under the International Companies Act (Cap. 77) and the Income Tax Repeal Act 2019: zero effective corporate tax, zero capital gains tax, zero dividend withholding tax, and zero branch remittance tax; VAT and customs duty exemptions are available on qualifying imports used for offshore e-commerce operations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return (Form VFSC/IC-AR) — electronic lodgement via the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission online company registry (CARS). No corporate income tax return is separately required because Vanuatu repealed its income tax for all entities; the IC annual return is the only statutory recurring filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 calendar days after the anniversary date of registration of the International Company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name and VFSC company number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the exact name from the certificate of incorporation; non-resident shareholders must not use a local residential address as the company name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office in Vanuatu and licensed registered agent details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A physical registered office in Port Vila or another Vanuatu address and a VFSC-licensed agent are compulsory; non-resident ownership does not excuse agent appointment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors, secretary (if any), and beneficial owners schedule.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose all individual and corporate shareholders and controllers holding a 10% or greater interest; nominee arrangements must be identified but are permissible.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of permitted activities and confirmation of no prohibited domestic trading or licensed activities without authorisation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm that the IC engages exclusively in offshore international commerce, including e-commerce sales of automotive aftermarket parts, and does not transact with Vanuatu residents or hold Vanuatu land.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing triggers a VFSC administrative penalty of VT 5,000 per month or part of a month plus restoration fees; persistent neglect can lead to automatic strike-off, freezing effects and cancellation of the IC certificate under Part 9 of the International Companies Act.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return (Form VAT 10) — Vanuatu Revenue & Customs online portal. Applicable only if the IC becomes VAT-registered; in the standard offshore e-commerce model the IC does not make Vanuatu domestic supplies and therefore has no VAT filing obligation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VAT returns are due within 30 days after the end of each quarter; if the IC is not VAT-registered, no deadline applies for income tax and this line is set to nil.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total value of Vanuatu taxable supplies (imports of goods or services into Vanuatu) during the calendar quarter.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident IC selling automotive aftermarket parts exclusively to foreign buyers through Stripe or PayPal, enter zero unless the goods are delivered to Vanuatu; registration never arises for pure offshore sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: VAT payable or receivable on local purchases or importation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If no taxpayer status, leave blank; non-resident ICs that invoice from Vanuatu must still rely on the IC exemption and obtain an advance ruling if there is any risk of deemed domestic supply.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of VT 10,000 per return; late-payment interest at 2% per month on outstanding VAT; evasion penalties may double the VAT shortfall and carry imprisonment up to five years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for International Company dividends to non-residents; Vanuatu imposes no general dividend withholding tax after the repeal of income tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No general tax treaty network applies. If the shareholder jurisdiction requires foreign tax credit relief, request a Certificate of Good Standing and a Certificate of Tax Exempt Status from the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission; a TRC is not issued by Vanuatu Revenue & Customs because Vanuatu does not tax foreign income. The certificate of incorporation plus the annual return acknowledgement is the functional substitute for treaty relief documentation.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory: 0% for IC payments to non-residents; treaty rate: 0% because Vanuatu has no comprehensive income tax treaties, and the IC regime renders cross-border royalties and interest tax-free regardless of treaty.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0: no local file or master file is required because Vanuatu levies no corporate income tax. However, any material intercompany transaction with a related party in another jurisdiction should be supported by contemporaneous arm's-length documentation for the partner jurisdiction's transfer-pricing audit; the effective threshold is zero where a foreign tax authority may recharacterise the IC's commercial substance.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not maintain a statutory Economic Substance Regulation regime. However, VFSC requires each International Company to maintain a licensed registered agent and physical registered office in Vanuatu and to keep accounting records at that office. The anti-abuse doctrine treats inadequate substance (no assets, no staff, no income records) as a non-residence red flag, exposing the IC to strike-off, cancellation of certificate, or taxation in the shareholder jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misclassifying imported automotive parts as zero-rated transit goods to avoid import duty and VAT; conspiracy to under-invoice customs entries; issuing false shipping invoices while receiving payments via Stripe or PayPal.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Customs and Excise Act and the Value Added Tax Act: forfeiture of goods, a civil penalty of up to 200% of the duty or tax evaded, a criminal fine of up to VT 10,000,000 (approximately USD 84,000), and imprisonment for up to seven years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may disregard the IC and impose personal liability on each director who signed or directed the false entry for the full amount of unpaid duty and penalty; directors may also be barred from leaving Vanuatu pending restitution and are personally subject to imprisonment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC to carry on Vanuatu-resident retail of automotive aftermarket parts, holding a local inventory warehouse, entering into contracts with Vanuatu consumers, or advertising as a Vanuatu domestic shop without migrating to the domestic company register and obtaining a local business licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: In addition to a VFSC penalty of VT 2,500,000 per violation (approximately USD 21,000), the IC registration is struck off and the certificate cancelled; each prohibited contract becomes voidable and the corporation loses the benefit of the tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly conducted domestic activities are jointly and severally liable for the company's debts and must restore all profits to creditors; the Court may impose a personal penalty of VT 1,000,000 and a travel ban for two years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Concealing the beneficial ownership of the auto-parts e-commerce platform through layered nominee shareholders; funnelling customer payments to offshore personal accounts; allowing the IC to be used to settle third-party trade debts without economic identity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act: entity-level penalty of VT 5,000,000, officer penalties of VT 1,000,000, seizure of all proceeds, exclusion from any regulated payment rail (Stripe or PayPal), and referral to the Public Prosecutor for criminal money-laundering indictment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers and directors may face personal fines up to VT 2,000,000 and imprisonment up to ten years; where funds have been laundered, the Court can order recovery against personal assets and impose a travel ban pending determination.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Selling automotive replacement parts or tuning accessories from the IC to parties subject to international sanctions, or using Vanuatu transshipment to circumvent US/EU export controls on high-performance automotive components destined for restricted jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Vanuatu's Sanctions Act 2006 empowers the Minister to freeze accounts, seize goods, and impose an administrative fine of VT 15,000,000 (approximately USD 126,000); criminal conviction for deliberate violation carries imprisonment up to ten years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who approve the controlled transaction are personally liable for the amount frozen or forfeited; a director may be imprisoned for up to ten years and may be made subject to a departure prevention order pending trial.
